# Source: Autumn (Harvesting and Wine Tasting), from The Four Seasons

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Autumn (Harvesting and Wine Tasting), from The Four Seasons
- **Artist / culture:** Attributed to Jan Saenredam (Dutch, 1565–1607) after Hendrick Goltzius (Dutch, 1558–1617)
- **Date:** c. 1595
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** print
- **Department:** Prints and Drawings
- **AIC artwork ID:** 267805
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/267805
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/fdb6f2de-98bb-1c94-4e26-0c581a4f0a4a/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Autumn and Harvest

## Extracted source palette

`#C8B8A8, #786868, #E8E8D8, #988888, #A8A898, #585848, #D8C8C8`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#3E3636`
- `surface`: `#544D4D`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#C8B8A8`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#585848`
- `surface_variant`: `#544D4D`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#726C6C`
- `error`: `#C8B8A8`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `6dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `11.06:1`, surface `7.76:1`
- Variant contrast: `7.76:1`
- Control contrast: `10.12:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
